description.zh: 要新建的用户的备注信息。最多支持500字符。
description.en: The remarks of the user that you want to add. The remarks can be up to 500 characters in length.

description.zh:
要新建的用户的显示姓名。最多支持128字符。
> 未填写则默认采用登录名作为显示姓名。
description.en:
The display name of the user that you want to add. The display name can be up to 128 characters in length.

> If you leave this parameter empty, the logon name is used as the display name.

description.zh: 用户有效期结束时间（秒，时间戳格式）
description.en: The end time of the validity period of the user. Specify a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

description.zh: 用户有效期开始时间（秒，时间戳格式）
description.en: The start time of the validity period of the user. Specify a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

description.zh:
要新建的用户的邮箱。
> - 当TwoFactorStatus为“Enable”，且TwoFactorMethods为“email”时，或当TwoFactorStatus为“Global”，且全局双因子配置中TwoFactorMethods为“email”时，该参数为必填。
> - 您可以调用[GetInstanceTwoFactor](~~462968~~)接口获取全局双因子配置
description.en:
The email address of the user that you want to add.

>

- This parameter is required if TwoFactorStatus is set to Enable and TwoFactorMethods is set to email, or if TwoFactorStatus is set to Global and TwoFactorMethods is set to email in the global two-factor authentication settings.

- You can call the [GetInstanceTwoFactor](~~462968~~) operation to query the global two-factor authentication settings.

description.zh:
要新建用户的堡垒机实例的ID。
>  您可以调用[DescribeInstances](~~153281~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the bastion host to which you want to add a user.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the bastion host ID.

description.zh:
当LanguageStatus为Custom 时，Language为必填。
取值：
- **zh-cn**：简体中文
- **en**：英文
description.en:
This parameter is required if LanguageStatus is set to Custom. Valid values:

- **zh-cn**: simplified Chinese.

- **en**: English.

description.zh:
消息通知语言设置。
- **Global**：遵循全局
- **Custom**：自定义

> 未填时默认为Global。
description.en:
Specifies whether to send notifications in the language specified in the global settings or a custom language.

- **Global**

- **Custom**

> If you leave this parameter empty, the default value Global is used.

description.zh:
要新建的用户的手机号码。
> - 当TwoFactorStatus为“Enable”，且TwoFactorMethods为“sms”或“dingtalk”时，或当TwoFactorStatus为“Global”，且全局双因子配置中TwoFactorMethods为“sms”或“dingtalk”时，该参数为必填。
> - 您可以调用[GetInstanceTwoFactor](~~462968~~)接口获取全局双因子配置
description.en:
The mobile phone number of the user that you want to add.

>

- This parameter is required if TwoFactorStatus is set to Enable and TwoFactorMethods is set to sms or dingtalk, or if TwoFactorStatus is set to Global and TwoFactorMethods is set to sms or dingtalk in the global two-factor authentication settings.

- You can call the [GetInstanceTwoFactor](~~462968~~) operation to query the global two-factor authentication settings.

The location where the mobile phone number of the user is registered. Default value: CN. Valid values:

- **CN**: the Chinese mainland, whose international dialing code is +86.

- **HK**: Hong Kong (China), whose international dialing code is +852.

- **MO**: Macao (China), whose international dialing code is +853.

- **TW**: Taiwan (China), whose international dialing code is +886.

- **RU**: Russia, whose international dialing code is +7.

- **SG**: Singapore, whose international dialing code is +65.

- **MY**: Malaysia, whose international dialing code is +60.

- **ID**: Indonesia, whose international dialing code is +62.

- **DE**: Germany, whose international dialing code is +49.

- **AU**: Australia, whose international dialing code is +61.

- **US**: US, whose international dialing code is +1.

- **AE**: United Arab Emirates, whose international dialing code is +971.

- **JP**: Japan, whose international dialing code is +81.

- **GB**: UK, whose international dialing code is +44.

- **IN**: India, whose international dialing code is +91.

- **KR**: Republic of Korea, whose international dialing code is +82.

- **PH**: Philippines, whose international dialing code is +63.

- **CH**: Switzerland, whose international dialing code is +41.

- **SE:** Sweden, whose international dialing code is +46.

- **SA:** Saudi Arabia, whose international dialing code is +966.

description.zh:
下次登录是否需要重置密码。取值：

- **true**：是
- **false**：否

> 未填时默认为false。
description.en:
Specifies whether password reset is required upon the next logon. Valid values:

- **true**

- **false**

> If you leave this parameter empty, the default value false is used.

description.zh:
要新建的用户的登录密码。 至少8位，至少包含大小写字母、数字、特殊符号，最多支持128字符。
> 新创建用户来源为本地用户（即Source取值为Local）时，该参数为必填项。
description.en:
The logon password of the user that you want to add. The logon password must be 8 to 128 characters in length. It must contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters.

> This parameter is required if Source is set to Local.

description.zh:
要新建的用户的堡垒机的地域ID。
>地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en:
The region ID of the bastion host to which you want to add a user.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

description.zh:
要新建的用户的来源。取值：

- **Local**：本地用户
- **Ram**：RAM用户
-  **AD**：AD用户
-  **LDAP**：LDAP用户
-  **IDaaS-EIAM**：IDaaS用户
description.en:
The type of the user that you want to add. Valid values:

- **Local**: a local user.

- **Ram**: a RAM user.

- **AD**: an AD-authenticated user.

- **LDAP**: an LDAP-authenticated user.

description.zh:
要新建的用户的唯一标识。
>- 该参数是堡垒机用户对应的RAM用户和IDaaS用户的唯一标识。新创建用户来源为RAM用户或IDaaS用户（即Source取值为Ram或IDaaS-EIAM）时，该参数为必填项。您可以调用访问控制的[ListUsers](~~28684~~)接口从返回数据UserId获取RAM用户该参数。可以调用EIAM云身份服务的[ListUsers](~~427814~~)接口从返回数据UserId获取IDaaS用户该参数
> - 新创建用户来源为AD或LDAP时，该参数为必填项，取值为用户的DN。
description.en:
The unique ID of the user that you want to add.

>

- This parameter uniquely identifies a RAM user of the bastion host. This parameter is required if Source is set to Ram. You can call the [ListUsers](~~28684~~) operation in RAM to obtain the unique ID of the user from the UserId response parameter.

- This parameter is required if Source is set to AD or LDAP. Specify the distinguished name (DN) of the Active Directory (AD)-authenticated user or Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP)-authenticated user that you want to add.

description.zh:
打开双因子认证方式的数组，目前最多支持一个，取值：

- **sms**：短信
- **email**：邮件
- **dingtalk**：钉钉
- **totp**：OTP令牌
- **gmusbkey**：国密USBKEY
>当TwoFactorStatus为“Enable”时，至少指定一种。
description.en:
The two-factor authentication method. You can select only one method. Valid values:

- **sms**: text message-based two-factor authentication.

- **email**: email-based two-factor authentication.

- **dingtalk**: DingTalk-based two-factor authentication.

- **totp OTP**: one-time password (OTP) token-based two-factor authentication.

> If TwoFactorStatus is set to Enable, you must select one of the preceding values for TwoFactorMethods.

description.zh:
用户双因子状态，取值：

- **Global**：遵循全局设定
- **Disable**：关闭双因子
- **Enable**：开启双因子，遵循单个用户设定

> 未填时默认为Global。
description.en:
Specifies whether two-factor authentication is enabled for the user. Valid values:

- **Global**: The global settings apply.

- **Disable**: Two-factor authentication is disabled.

- **Enable**: Two-factor authentication is enabled and user-specific settings apply.

> If you leave this parameter empty, the default value Global is used.

description.zh: 要新建的用户的登录名称。该参数只能由字母、数字、下划线（_）组成，最多支持128字符。
description.en: The logon name of the user that you want to add. The logon name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain only letters, digits, and underscores (\_).

descriptions.zh:
本接口用于创建堡垒机的用户，支持添加本地用户、RAM用户、AD用户和LDAP用户。堡垒机管理员为运维员创建登录堡垒机的账户（即新建用户）后，运维员才能使用该账户登录堡垒机运维已授权的主机。

本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
Adds local users, Resource Access Management (RAM) users, Active Directory (AD)-authenticated users, or Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP)-authenticated users to a bastion host. After adding a user, O\&M engineers can log on to the bastion host with that account to perform O\&M operations on authorized hosts.

You can call this operation up to 10 times per second per account. If the number of the calls per second exceeds a limit, throttling is triggered. As a result, your business may be affected. We recommend that you take note of the limits when you call this operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost create-user --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --source Local --user-name abc_def --password 2130000 --display-name Bob --comment comment --email username@example.com --mobile 13599990000 --source-user-id 1227489245380000 --mobile-country-code CN --effective-start-time 1669630029 --effective-end-time 1672502400 --need-reset-password true --two-factor-status Enable --two-factor-methods sms --language-status Custom --biz-language en --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost CreateUser --region cn-hangzhou --Comment comment --UserName abc_def --Email 'username@example.com' --InstanceId 'bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000' --SourceUserId 1227489245380000 --MobileCountryCode CN --TwoFactorStatus Enable --Mobile 13599990000 --Source Local --EffectiveEndTime 1672502400 --EffectiveStartTime 1669630029 --Language en --TwoFactorMethods sms --DisplayName Bob --NeedResetPassword true --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --LanguageStatus Custom --Password 2130000
